Scenario: Chills run down your spine as you are greeted by a pale blue specter wearing robes from a different era.
Log Version: I encountered a pale blue specter!

Scenario: You're filled with dread as a headless phantom materializes in front of you. A severed head sways from matted black locks entangled in its fist.
Log Version: I encountered a headless phantom!

Scenario: An apparition of a young girl mounted atop a translucent bike\u201a with training wheels\u201a strolls towards you silently.
Log Version: I observed an apparition of a young girl on a bicycle!

Scenario: A minotaur-like hoofed entity circles above you, suspended in the air. It grins at you with black teeth sharper than its gnarled horns.
Log Version: I witnessed a demonic apparition!

Scenario: An unknown voice emits a sinister giggle. In front of you, a demonic clown performs a juggling act.
Log Version: A demonic clown appeared in front of me!

Scenario: An invisible, barreling force rams into your legs, knocking you to the floor. A ghostly dog begins licking at your cheek with an icy tongue.
Log Version: The ghost of a dog licked my face!

Scenario: A white gowned woman is wailing as she floats by you. Her face is muffled and concealed by clasped, bony hands. She lets out a frustrated shriek.
Log Version: A banshee shrieked at me!

Scenario: A pale, spectral being crawls past you on all fours, clicking and chirping as it shuffles. It looks at you, then stops abruptly.
Log Version: I encountered a crawling phantom!

Scenario: The apparition of a man dressed in a train conductor's uniform appears before you. In a solemn expression, he slowly places a cold hand on your shoulder.
Log Version: I observed a solemn ghost dressed as a train conductor!

Scenario: Ominous, orchestral music fills your ears as a waltzing, debonair ghost of a man prances into existence. He doesn't miss a beat.
Log Version: I watched a waltzing spirit dance in front of me!

Scenario: A raven-haired female specter thinly cloaked in diaphanous lace suddenly appears, tiptoeing toward you with a seductive gaze.
Log Version: I encountered a specter!

Scenario: The spirit of a bald pudgy boy appears waddling before you. Just as you make eye contact, he vomits black, gelatinous ectoplasm all over you.
Log Version: The ghost of a bald pudgy boy vomited all over me!

Scenario: The figure of a middle-aged mobster emerges from the shadows. He reaches into his pinstripe suit coat pocket to reveal a translucent revolver, then points it at you.
Log Version: I encountered the ghost of a mobster!

Scenario: A very tall and gangly spectral figure of a man suddenly appears. He points at you then drags his thumb across his neck in a throat-slitting gesture.
Log Version: I was threatened by a tall, gangly specter!

Scenario: The spirit of a monk sitting cross-legged appears directly in front of you. The tips of his brown robe dissolve into the air.
Log Version: I observed the ghost of a monk!

Scenario: A phantom masked in a Victorian diving helmet suddenly appears. Blinding rays of light beam from the faceplate as it quickly approaches you.
Log Version: I observed the ghost of a deep-sea diver!

Scenario: A group of ghostly children appear before you. After a brief silence, the least among them, a shy young girl, bashfully moves towards you with hand extended.
Log Version: I encountered the ghost of a young girl!

Scenario: A ghoulish dismembered head appears out of thin air and flies past your ear. The severed mess pilots the room aloft then darts back at your face.
Log Version: A floating head attacked me!

Scenario: The ghost of an elderly man dressed in overalls appears on your porch, rocking in a chair made of shadows. Seemingly oblivious to your presence, he strums a melancholic tune on his banjo.
Log Version: The ghost of an old man playing a banjo appeared on my porch!

Scenario: The terrifying ghost of a woman, wearing a straitjacket, suddenly appears and starts flying around the room.
Log Version: I saw the ghost of a woman wearing a straitjacket!
